# Tools

Every program in `bin/`, each page generated from the program's own docstring. Every tool refuses what `RULES.md` says it refuses; the page quotes the tool, the rules are the authority.

| tool | what it does |
|---|---|
| [`annotate-claim`](annotate-claim.md) | Appends a note to CLAIMS.md for an existing entry: |
| [`approve`](approve.md) | Prints path, size and sha256 of everything the approval is bound to, writes a single-use record that expires in 30 minutes, and ledgers an APPROVE line. |
| [`astra-session`](astra-session.md) | Launch Claude Code routed at OpenRouter with OpenAI GPT-6 Astra as the session model. |
| [`check`](check.md) | The Checker of RULES.md step 2: |
| [`check-env`](check-env.md) | What this machine offers the kit, one line each: |
| [`claim-deps`](claim-deps.md) | Dependencies between CLAIMS.md entries. |
| [`claims-extract`](claims-extract.md) | The worker's view of the ledger. |
| [`close-run`](close-run.md) | RULES.md steps 2–4 in one command, plus the two lines the orchestrator would otherwise compose by hand. |
| [`handoff-archive`](handoff-archive.md) | Copies the current HANDOFF.md to handoffs/YYYY-MM-DD-HHMM-<git short sha\|uncommitted>-<session>.md so that no rewrite of the handoff ever loses the previous version. |
| [`ledger`](ledger.md) | Append one line to the global append-only ledger. |
| [`ledger-claims`](ledger-claims.md) | RULES.md step 5. |
| [`limits-exec`](limits-exec.md) | Runs a command as a worker process tree under the run's enforced limits: |
| [`lint-brief`](lint-brief.md) | Read-only for the run. |
| [`manifest`](manifest.md) | The orchestrator runs this before a user gate so the user sees the exact paths, hashes and digest an approval would bind. |
| [`merge`](merge.md) | RULES.md step 4. |
| [`new-run`](new-run.md) | Creates WORKSPACE/runs/NNN-SLUG/{BRIEF.md,input/,scratch/,output/} with NNN = 1 + the highest run number across all workspaces (run names are unique project-wide). |
| [`new-workspace`](new-workspace.md) | Makes one instance of the kit for one problem, at DIR (outside the kit), and stops. |
| [`packet-block`](packet-block.md) | Adds to data/packet-rules.json, the instance's list of what no worker's packet may carry (bin/_packet.py): |
| [`packet-except`](packet-except.md) | Adds FILE, by its sha256, to data/packet-exceptions.json: |
| [`run-external`](run-external.md) | Launch one worker as a headless MAIN process (not a subagent) on one of three routes: |
| [`validate-claims`](validate-claims.md) | validate-claims [RUN_DIR] (RUN_DIR defaults to $KIT_RUN, then the current directory) |
| [`verify-data`](verify-data.md) | Prints `root: |
| [`watch-run`](watch-run.md) | Human-readable view of a run's transcript (Claude Code stream-json or Codex events). |
